summary: Tested the store-readiness pack and password flows. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (change-password 400/400/422/401/200, session rotation, old cookies and old refresh token get 401, old/new password login, 5 wrong attempts then 429, works on an expired-trial org, forgot-password gives the same generic 200 for registered and unregistered emails, sha256 token_hash stored, demo login sets httpOnly cookie, bcrypt $2b$, assetlinks.json 200 application/json). Web /app/profile Change Password card: empty, <8 chars, mismatch and wrong-current errors all render; success shows a toast, clears the fields, and the session survives a reload. Mobile: m-login-forgot-link goes to /forgot-password; m-change-password sheet shows the mismatch, wrong-password and success toasts and closes on success; m-privacy-link goes to /privacy and back works. /privacy and /terms render at 1920 and 390 with no horizontal overflow, the company name and mailto are correct, and the other-link, back link and footer links work. Register consent text is present on web step 3 and mobile step 3. At 390px the WhatsApp button (y 700-748) and sticky CTA (y 775-844) do not overlap. In-app mode works on /m/* and on direct /app/subscription?app=1 loads. One bug: ?app=1 on landing (/), /login or /privacy does NOT set localStorage gb-in-app.

ui_bugs.issue: isInApp() is only called at module level inside lazily-loaded Subscription.jsx and mobile Profile.jsx (which MobileApp loads with it). Loading /?app=1, /login?app=1 or /privacy?app=1 on a fresh browser leaves localStorage gb-in-app = null. Reproduced: fresh /login?app=1, log in, SPA-navigate to /app/subscription -> subscribe-button shown, in-app-billing-note missing. If the TWA/Capacitor start_url is / or /login, the Razorpay pay buttons WILL show inside the store app (store policy risk).

`const inApp = isInApp()` runs once when the module loads, so the value is stale until a full reload (e.g. after removing the flag, or if the flag is set after the chunk has loaded). Better to read it once at boot (index.js / App.js) and keep it in context, or call it inside the component.

issues: The Terms/Privacy consent links open in the same tab, so the user leaves and loses the partly filled form. Use target=_blank or keep the form state.
m-login-forgot-link opens the web /forgot-password page; after a reset, ResetPassword navigates to the web /login instead of /m/login, so a mobile/in-app user leaves the /m shell.

The sidebar 'Upgrade Now' (upgrade-now-button-*) and the plan price cards still show in in-app mode. They only lead to the note, but Apple 3.1.1 reviewers may flag purchase CTAs. Consider hiding or relabelling them in-app.
'Last updated: June 2026' is hardcoded. Confirm the date is intended.

action_items: HIGH: call isInApp() once at app boot (src/index.js or App.js, before routing) so ?app=1 on any route (/ , /login, /privacy, ...) persists gb-in-app. Also keep the value in a context or read it inside the components instead of a module-level const.
Open the register consent Terms/Privacy links in a new tab (web + mobile).
Optional: the mobile forgot/reset flow should return to /m/login; hide the 'Upgrade Now' CTAs in in-app mode.
critical_code_review_comments: loadRazorpayScript() is duplicated in pages/app/Subscription.jsx and mobile/screens/Profile.jsx. Move it to lib/razorpay.js.
change_password stores the lockout in login_attempts with email='chpw:<id>'. This works but mixes namespaces; a separate collection or a type field would be cleaner.

Backend change-password logic is solid: it verifies the current password, rejects reusing the same password, bumps token_version, re-issues cookies, clears reset tokens, and locks out per user after 5 wrong attempts in 15 minutes.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (in-app flag persistence fails on non-/m, non-subscription entry routes)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run test_iter17_store_auth.py (it registers its own users and uses pymongo via backend/.env for expiry/token checks). To retest the in-app fix: in a fresh browser open /?app=1 (or /login?app=1) and check localStorage gb-in-app === '1', then log in and SPA-navigate to /app/subscription and /m/profile; expect in-app-billing-note and no subscribe-button / m-pay-button.
rca of the issue: In-app flag: inApp.js only writes localStorage when isInApp() runs. Its only callers are module-level consts in Subscription.jsx and mobile Profile.jsx, which are lazy-loaded (MobileApp loads Profile with it, so /m/* works). Entering on any other route with ?app=1 never runs isInApp(), and the query string is gone after SPA navigation. Fix: call isInApp() in src/index.js before render.
